# RQ-91-M0FLAGS (#1301) NZCV verifier probe set, cold review 10: 228 + 9 llvm-mc-assembled
# Thumb streams with expected verdicts. Contracts: P=Preserves S=Scratch W=Writes(NZCV)
# W0=Writes(0) (the flag-setting variants) Wc=Writes(N|Z). Format: name|hex|segments|EXPECTED
# Expectations changed from the review's draft .exp (22), each by the rule it follows:
#  - REJECT, unknown BY DESIGN (review 10 N4: valid but never emitted, refused as unknown):
#    smlabb, sadd8, umaal, pld, ldrex, strex, cpsid, wls, dls, tt, mrc p1 -> r5 (coprocessor 1),
#    clrm {r0,r1} (LDM with Rn = PC).
#  - REJECT, R2: the two 'vmrs; island; it mi' streams put VMRS in a Preserves op, so its
#    flags may not leave the op (the cases10b variant with VMRS as Writes is ACCEPT).
#  - ACCEPT, nothing clobbers: vselgt.f64 only READS N,Z,V between cmp and beq; and the seven
#    nokill[...] producers (vmrs APSR_nzcv, msr apsr/xpsr_nzcvq, cmp.w, teq.w, rsbs, negs.w) sit
#    in a Writes(NZCV) op and fully rewrite Z, so the earlier movs's Z is dead.
# The last 9 cases (cases10b) carry the lane's expectations: islands between a producer and its
# reader ACCEPT; vselgt after a movs clobber, mrc to APSR_nzcv, clrm {apsr} and asrl REJECT.
